newsitem.title: USA: LPC-$500 mln Codelco loan may set Chile benchmark.
newsitem.headline: LPC-$500 mln Codelco loan may set Chile benchmark.

text.p: NEW YORK, August 26 (LPC) - Chilean copper conglomerate Codelco has invited bank proposals for a $500 million loan, a transaction that may set pricing lows for Chilean borrowers, banking sources said.

Bidding on the credit is expected to be fierce, and the loan might be priced as little as 30 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), sources added. The current benchmark is 35 basis points over LIBOR, recently earned by Banco del Estado de Chile, a banker said.
Bids for the new loan, which will be structured as either a five- to seven-year bullet or a seven-year amortizing loan, are due September 5, bankers said.

Codelco is the largest copper producer in the world and one of the lowest cost producers. The Chilean government is highly reliant on Codelco and has as strong interest in the health of the company, according to analysts.

Despite wobbly copper prices, Codelco remains a highly profitable company. Following a drop in copper prices, the company estimated profits will decline from $1.7 billion in 1995 to $1.2 billion in 1996.
